sourceNote.en: These are Airbnb’s English automatic translations of reviews written in Hebrew. Each one is shown with a first name and the month and year. For the Hebrew originals and anything posted since, use the listing.
sourceNote.he: הביקורות נכתבו במקור בעברית. כאן מופיע התרגום האוטומטי של Airbnb לאנגלית, עם שם פרטי וחודש בלבד. את המקור העברי וכל ביקורת חדשה יותר אפשר לקרוא ברשימה.

quote.en: It was just fun. A house in an excellent location, inviting and very pleasant to be in. The landlords are kind and available. We are really happy that we got to stay at their place.
quote.he: It was just fun. A house in an excellent location, inviting and very pleasant to be in. The landlords are kind and available. We are really happy that we got to stay at their place.

quote.en: We had a wonderful stay. Aaron's place is inviting, cozy and indulgent. The house is sparkling clean and everything is accessible. This is the great advantage of a house where you live and not a house that is intended only for rentals. We had everything there. The kids were in the well-maintained pool, playing X-box, and the whole family sat around the table with board games from the house. BBQ grill in the yard, fully equipped kitchen, coffee machine, ice machine, cold water. A supermarket is a 3-minute walk away. Aaron was available and attentive to any questions we had. We are definitely going back there.
